# Independent SIDIS NNLO reference

Authors: Juliane Haug and Fabian Wunder, arXiv:2505.18109v2,
https://arxiv.org/html/2505.18109v2 . Retrieved from the authors' arXiv ancillary
directory https://arxiv.org/src/2505.18109v2/anc on 2026-09-10.
These files are validation-only; no production module reads them.

The polarized ancillary header explicitly defines rln2 = Log[2], resolving
an abbreviation absent from the original FORM header of arXiv:2404.08597v3.
The original piecewise FORM expressions remain the primary comparison.
The single-valued representation provides an additional independent check
of the reference translation and continuation.
